name: Dusk
description: Fill the grid with suns and moons: balanced rows, no three alike, follow = and ×.
hint: Click: sun, moon, empty · right-click back · arrows + Space · ⌘Z undo

howTo.goal: Fill every cell with a sun or a moon.
rules: Each row and each column has as many suns as moons.
Never three of the same next to each other, across or down.
= between two cells means they're the same; × means they're different.
Every puzzle has exactly one answer.
